regimes.name: Arrival
regimes.description: Biological birth; early sensory anchoring; total dependence on external scaffolding.

regimes.name: Expansion
regimes.description: Cognitive, social, and emotional patterning; identity formation; environmental scanning.

regimes.name: Inversion
regimes.description: Adolescence, existential rupture, trauma, awakening, or major life reconfiguration.

regimes.name: Coherence
regimes.description: Self-authored structure; intentional navigation of multiple regimes.

regimes.name: Dissolution
regimes.description: Biological decline; cognitive narrowing; return to substrate.
